scripts.docker:build: docker build -t seethrough-api -f apps/api/docker/Dockerfile . && docker build -t seethrough-web -f apps/web/docker/Dockerfile . && docker build -t seethrough-agent -f apps/agent/docker/Dockerfile . && docker build -t seethrough-kubernetes-agent -f apps/kubernetes-agent/docker/Dockerfile .
scripts.minikube:build: minikube image build -t local/seethrough:api-latest -f apps/api/docker/Dockerfile . && minikube image build -t local/seethrough:web-latest -f apps/web/docker/Dockerfile . && minikube image build -t local/seethrough:node-agent-latest -f apps/node-agent/docker/Dockerfile . && minikube image build -t local/seethrough:kubernetes-agent-latest -f apps/kubernetes-agent/docker/Dockerfile .
scripts.minikube:reload: yarn minikube:build && kubectl rollout restart deployment/api deployment/web daemonset/node-agent deployment/kubernetes-agent
scripts.minikube:configure: minikube addons enable volumesnapshots && minikube addons enable csi-hostpath-driver && minikube addons disable storage-provisioner && minikube addons disable default-storageclass && kubectl patch storageclass csi-hostpath-sc -p '{"metadata": {"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"true"}}}'
scripts.minikube:recreate: minikube delete || true && minikube start && yarn minikube:configure
